title: shared Mirror experts plus rare private expert
hypothesis: When three common routed experts share a base under Givens views and one rare expert is independent, assigning one private expert matrix only to the rare role plus shared Mirror views for common roles recovers quality at materially lower payload than a four-expert MoE; all-shared Mirror should fail at the private outlier.
physical_object: one shared linear expert matrix for common roles, plus a candidate single private matrix for the rare role
mirror_coordinate: three common-role Givens coordinate vectors; rare role optionally private
logical_multiplicity: four hard-routed expert functions under strongly skewed role frequencies

task.routing: deterministic role from signs of x0,x1; supplied identically to every method
task.input_distribution: standard Gaussian shifted by +1.2 on x0 and x1, making the negative-negative role rare (~1.3%)

teacher_modes.shared_common_private_rare: roles 1-3 are shared-base Givens views; role 0 has an independent matrix

task.structure_audit: rare-role MSE plus balanced-input overall MSE

controls: one tied common matrix plus one private rare matrix
one shared matrix plus rank-1 per-role residuals
Mirror views for common roles plus one private rare matrix

development.selection_metric: mean natural-frequency MSE pooled across methods and teacher modes

training.router: oracle deterministic hard route; routing quality is outside this experiment

storage.authority: actual serialized full inference payload bytes
storage.serialization: torch.save state_dict plus deterministic config JSON

success_gate: In all three fresh shared-common/private-rare worlds, Mirror-plus-private-rare is within 1.10x full MoE on natural-frequency and rare-role MSE, uses <=0.80x full-MoE payload, and beats all-Mirror, tied-plus-private, and rank-1 residual controls at its measured payload. Independent-all mode maps where one private matrix is insufficient.
failure_gate: In two or more fresh shared-common/private-rare worlds, Mirror-plus-private-rare misses quality or byte gates, or a simpler control matches its quality at equal/lower payload. Failure on independent-all alone is a capacity boundary, not an overall failure.
boundaries: role labels are provided; no learned-routing claim
skewed role prior is part of the tested task
teacher deliberately aligns common roles with Givens views

protocol_amendments.reason: The measured actual serialized payload for Mirror-common plus one private expert was 3,745B vs 4,841B full MoE (0.774x). The registered 0.70x threshold was below the measured serializer-inclusive floor for this architecture and did not represent the intended >=20% useful payload reduction.
protocol_amendments.change: Set the full-payload gate to <=0.80x full MoE, still requiring at least 20% actual serialized-byte reduction. Keep quality gates, methods, worlds, training budget and selection unchanged.
